Description:
This test verifies inline editing of the *Label field* in both *Overview* and *Side Panel*.

* Editing the Label field in *Overview* and *Side Panel*
* Selecting a single value
* Selecting multiple values
* Creating a new Label
* Removing selected values
* Data consistency between Overview and Side Panel

Steps:
1. *Prerequisites:* 5x Labels are created in OKR module
   Data: labelsName: Label 1, Label 2, Label 3, Label 4, Label 5
   Expected: 
2. Open OKR Overview of boxName and create Objective and Key-result
   Data: boxName: TC-6094 SPM - OKR - Inline editing of Label field

* objectiveName: Objective 1
* key-resultName: Key-result 1
   Expected: Objective and Key-result are created and visible in OKR overview
3. Hover over the Objective and Key-result Label fields
   Expected: The row is highlighted (grey background) when the user hovers over it
+ button and tooltip "Add Labels" is displayed
4. Click on + button next to Objective Label field
   Expected: Dropdown is displayed with lists of Labels. Create Label button visible in dropdown
5. Add labelName
   Data: labelName: Label 1
   Expected: Label 1 is displayed in Label field for Objective
6. Click on the grey area of the Objective row
   Expected: Side panel is opened on the right side and displays details of the selected Objective. The Objective Label is consistent with the value in Overview
7. Click in Label field in Side panel
   Expected: Dropdown is displayed with lists of Labels. Create Label button visible in dropdown
8. Add next labelsName
   Data: labelName: Label 2, Label 3, Label 4, Label 5
   Expected: The list of labelName ( 5x labels with full name and icons) is displayed in Label field in Side panel
9. Navigate to Overview and hover over to Team field next to Objective
   Expected: Label field display 5x labels
10. Select Label field and click X Clear button
   Expected: Field is empty, all labels disappear from Overview
11. Hover over the Key-result Label fields → Click on + button
   Expected: Dropdown is displayed with lists of Labels. Create Label button visible in dropdown
12. Click Create label
   Expected: Create label modal is displayed
13. fill in the name, select background color (green) and click Create
   Data: labelName: Label 6
   Expected: Label is created and visible
